My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?

When tracking shows "delivered" but the package has not been found, it may have been left in an unexpected location or could arrive shortly after the delivery scan. Here are the steps to take:



Check around your delivery address, including front door, side door, back door, garage, mailroom, porch, or other secure locations.


Check with household members, neighbors, or building staff.


Allow up to 24–48 hours after the delivery scan, as packages are sometimes found within that window.



If your order shipped in multiple boxes, each box can have its own tracking number and delivery timing, so it is worth confirming whether there are additional packages still in transit.
